name: Kawaii
traits: soft rounded forms with no sharp corners
minimal faces: dot eyes and a tiny mouth, placed low
pastel palette with cheerful motifs (stars, hearts, clouds, sparkles)
objects and plants given small faces and personalities
bestFor: character-led product ads where the product gets a face
suits: sweets, drinks, skincare, plant care, stationery, pet products; soft, friendly, caring brands
stylePara: Kawaii cute illustration in motion: every form is soft and rounded, with no sharp corners; faces are minimal, two small black dot eyes set wide and low and a tiny curved mouth, with pink blush ovals; outlines are thick, soft, rounded and dark brown rather than black; colour is a gentle pastel palette of peach, mint, butter yellow, lilac and sky blue on cream, with flat fills and a single very light shadow; cheerful motifs float in the space: small stars, clouds, hearts, sparkles; plants and objects may carry tiny faces; clean, simple, sweet compositions with lots of breathing room.

rendering.line: thick rounded dark-brown line with round caps, even weight
rendering.shading: nearly flat: one very light shadow tone, blush ovals, tiny white highlight dots
rendering.colour: pastel palette (peach, mint, butter, lilac, sky blue, cream); the product keeps its exact colours, softened only by the light, never recoloured
rendering.texture: smooth, clean fills; optional faint paper grain
rendering.lighting: soft, shadowless, cheerful daylight; no dramatic contrast

motion: Gentle, bouncy motion on twos: soft squash and stretch, little hops and wiggles, slow bobbing idle loops, motifs twinkling and floating upward; reactions are small and sweet (a happy squint, a little jump); nothing fast or sharp.
camera: Centred, symmetrical compositions with the subject in the middle; slow push-ins and gentle floating drifts; frontal staging; no aggressive angles or fast cuts.
avoid: detailed realistic faces with noses and irises
harsh black outlines and deep shadows
hearts and stars turning into letters or emoji
sheets: Each character sheet shows the rounded figure front, three-quarter and side with the dot-eye placement exact, in the pastel palette with a colour chip row; any object or plant with a face gets its own small sheet (face position, expressions); the product keeps its exact proportions and colours and is shown with and without a face.
risk: Seedance adds noses, irises and more detail to minimal faces as the clip goes on, and moves dot eyes around; keep the sheet in every shot. If the product is given a face, the model may also redesign its shape or label; bind the product reference strictly and add the face only as two dots and a mouth on the label-free part. Floating motifs can multiply into clutter; name how many.

example.prompt: Kawaii cute illustration still: a soft rounded woman in her thirties with a dark bun and an orange top, dot eyes set low, a tiny smile and pink blush ovals, cradles a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap; a pastel sunny kitchen of rounded peach and mint shapes, beside a droopy fern on the windowsill with a tiny sad dot-eyed face, two small stars and a cloud floating above; thick rounded dark-brown outlines, flat pastel colour, lots of breathing room. Vertical 9:16. No text.
